newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK & China Gas 96 net within estimates.
newsitem.headline: HK & China Gas 96 net within estimates.

text.p: Hong Kong and China Gas Co Ltd's 1996 net profit was in line with consensus expectations, with the company reporting a 19 percent rise compared with forecasts of 16 to 20 percent growth, analysts said.
China Gas, the sole town gas producer and distributor in Hong Kong, posted net profit of HK$1.95 billion for calendar 1996 compared with HK$1.64 billion in 1995.
"The profit growth is pretty much in line with expectation," said Alice Hui, an analyst at W.I. Carr.
Shares of China Gas erased a HK$0.05 morning loss on Thursday afternoon to trade unchanged at HK$14.60.
